# Loading Libraries and Data

```{r warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}
library(TCGAbiolinks)
library(SummarizedExperiment)
library(dplyr)
library(limma)
library(survival)
library(survminer)
library(ggplot2)
library(sva)
library(reshape2)
library(caret)
library(glmnet)
library(stringr)
library(tibble)
library(survcomp)

data <- load("SKCM.rda")
clinical_followup <- read.csv("clinical_followup.csv")

# Extract clinical data
clinical <- colData(query2) %>% 
  as.data.frame() %>%
  dplyr::select(gender, vital_status, days_to_death, 
               ajcc_pathologic_stage, age_at_diagnosis)

# Create proper survival object
clinical <- clinical %>%
  mutate(
    # Calculate survival time in years
    survival_time = ifelse(vital_status == "Alive", NA, days_to_death / 365),
    event = ifelse(vital_status == "Dead", 1, 0),
    
    # Convert age to years
    age_diagnosis = age_at_diagnosis / 365
  ) %>%
  # Handle missing values
  mutate(
    age_diagnosis = ifelse(is.na(age_diagnosis), median(age_diagnosis, na.rm = TRUE), age_diagnosis),
    ajcc_pathologic_stage = ifelse(is.na(ajcc_pathologic_stage), "Unknown", ajcc_pathologic_stage)
  )

clinical <- clinical %>%
  mutate(patient_barcode = str_sub(rownames(clinical), 1, 12)) %>%
  mutate(full_barcode = rownames(clinical))

# First, select the most recent follow-up entry for each patient
followup_latest <- clinical_followup %>%
  group_by(bcr_patient_barcode) %>%
  filter(!is.na(days_to_last_followup)) %>%
  slice_max(order_by = days_to_last_followup, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  select(bcr_patient_barcode, days_to_last_followup)

clinical<- clinical %>%
  left_join(followup_latest, by = c("patient_barcode" = "bcr_patient_barcode"))

clinical <- clinical %>%
  column_to_rownames("full_barcode")

clinical <- clinical %>%
  mutate(
    days_to_death = ifelse(vital_status == "Alive", days_to_last_followup, days_to_death),
    survival_time = ifelse(vital_status == "Alive", days_to_last_followup / 365, survival_time)
  )

clinical <- clinical%>%
  select(-patient_barcode, -days_to_last_followup, -age_at_diagnosis)

clinical <- clinical %>%
  filter(!is.na(survival_time))

clinical <- clinical %>%
  filter(survival_time > 0)

fpkm <- assay(query2, "fpkm_uq_unstrand")

log_expr <- log2(fpkm + 1)
```


```{r}
ids <- as.character(colData(query2)$barcode)
batch <- sapply(strsplit(ids, "-"), function(x) {
  if (length(x) >= 6) return(x[6]) else return(NA)
})


gene_var <- apply(log_expr, 1, var)
log_expr_filtered <- log_expr[gene_var > 0, ]
```

# Batch Correction

```{r message=FALSE}
# ComBat 
modcombat <- model.matrix(~1, data = data.frame(batch = batch))
combat_expr <- ComBat(dat = as.matrix(log_expr_filtered),
                      batch = batch,
                      mod = modcombat,
                      par.prior = TRUE,
                      prior.plots = FALSE)
```

# Cox Survival Model

```{r}
# # Filter to ensure the samples match between clinical and gene expression data
# combat_expr_filtered <- combat_expr[, rownames(clinical)]

# Convert relevant character variables to factors
clinical$gender <- as.factor(clinical$gender)
clinical$vital_status <- as.factor(clinical$vital_status)
clinical$ajcc_pathologic_stage <- as.factor(clinical$ajcc_pathologic_stage)

```

```{r}
gene_expr <- log_expr_filtered

# Prepare the expression matrix and survival data
common_samples <- intersect(rownames(clinical), colnames(gene_expr))

# Subset both datasets to those common samples
X <- t(gene_expr[, common_samples])  # transpose after subsetting

# Remove genes with near-zero variance (optional but helps)
X <- X[, apply(X, 2, sd, na.rm = TRUE) > 1e-5]

# 2. Create the survival object
y <- Surv(clinical$survival_time, clinical$event)

# Fit LASSO Cox model using cross-validation to choose lambda
set.seed(123)  # for reproducibility
cv_fit <- cv.glmnet(X, y, family = "cox", alpha = 1)

# Extract coefficients at the best lambda
lasso_coef <- coef(cv_fit, s = "lambda.min")
selected_genes <- rownames(lasso_coef)[as.vector(lasso_coef) != 0]

# Subset gene expression matrix by selected genes
selected_expr <- gene_expr[selected_genes, , drop = FALSE]  # genes x patients

# Transpose to get patients x genes (for merging)
selected_expr_t <- t(selected_expr)

# Ensure rownames match clinical data
# (both should have patient barcodes as rownames)
common_patients <- intersect(rownames(clinical), rownames(selected_expr_t))

# Subset both datasets to the common patients
clinical_subset <- clinical[common_patients, , drop = FALSE]
expr_subset <- selected_expr_t[common_patients, , drop = FALSE]

# Combine into one data frame
cox_data <- cbind(clinical_subset, expr_subset)

cox_data <- cox_data %>%
  select(-days_to_death)
```


# Fit Cox Model

```{r}
# Convert categorical variables to dummy variables
gender_dummies <- model.matrix(~ gender - 1, data = cox_data)
vital_status_dummies <- model.matrix(~ vital_status - 1, data = cox_data)
ajcc_stage_dummies <- model.matrix(~ ajcc_pathologic_stage - 1, data = cox_data)

# Combine the dummy variables with the numeric gene expression data
# Exclude the columns for survival_time and event (columns 4 and 5)
x <- cbind(cox_data[, -c(4, 5, 1, 2, 3)], gender_dummies, vital_status_dummies, ajcc_stage_dummies)

x <- as.matrix(x)

# Ensure survival data is in the correct format
y <- Surv(cox_data$survival_time, cox_data$event)

# Fit the Cox model with the glmnet
cv_fit <- cv.glmnet(x, y, family = "cox")

lambda_min <- cv_fit$lambda.min

cox_summary <- summary(cv_fit)

# Get the linear predictors for each observation (risk scores)
risk_scores <- predict(cv_fit, s = lambda_min, newx = x, type = "link")

# Calculate concordance index
c_index <- concordance.index(x = risk_scores,
                             surv.time = cox_data$survival_time,
                             surv.event = cox_data$event,
                             method = "noether")

# Build the formula: include selected genes and any clinical covariates you want
selected_vars <- colnames(cox_data)[!(colnames(cox_data) %in% c("survival_time", "event"))]

# Build the formula dynamically
cox_formula <- as.formula(paste("Surv(survival_time, event) ~", paste(selected_vars, collapse = " + ")))

# Fit Cox proportional hazards model using coxph
cox_model <- coxph(cox_formula, data = cox_data)

```

```{r warning=FALSE}
ggsurvplot(survfit(Surv(cox_data$survival_time, cox_data$event) ~ 1), 
           data = cox_data, 
           risk.table = TRUE,       
           pval = TRUE,             
           conf.int = TRUE,         
           xlab = "Survival Time",  
           ylab = "Survival Probability", 
           title = "Survival Curve for Cox Model")
```


## Metrics

| Concordance     | AIC |
|-----------------|----|
| `r c_index$c.index`| `r AIC(cox_model)` |
-------------------

- The Concordance value indicates a relatively strong agreement between the variables.
